note: Scripted family lines for the live-voice simulator tests. Text is the 繁體中文 source, spoken as written by Qwen3-TTS VoiceDesign (synth_qwen.py). Speakers are sound characters (a voice-design description each), not people's names; `persona` is the simulator family member who says it by default (duckmind.world.people.PERSONAS). Optional per line: `say`, the words handed to the TTS when they differ from `text`; `take`, the take build.py keeps instead of the one it would pick.

mom.instruction: 一位温柔的中年女性，声音清晰亲切，语速适中。

dad.instruction: 一位沉稳的中年男性，声音低沉温和，语速适中。

child.instruction: 一个活泼的小孩子，声音清脆明亮，语气开心。

grandpa.instruction: 一位年长的男性，声音略带沙哑，语速缓慢，语气慈祥。

lines.speaker: mom
lines.why_take: the barge-in scenario: mom must start clearly over the duck's call and talk past its end
